title: Riverton City Council Meeting
motion: adopt Ordinance No. 22-22, the Master Development Agreement for Riverton Ranch Estates, establishing requirements, standards, and parameters for development of an eight (8) lot private lane subdivision accessing a private lane at approximately 13040 S. Redwood Road as presented with the following conditions: 1) redline corrections and issues be corrected prior to recordation of the subdivision plat; and 2) solid fencing, consistent with Riverton City’s ordinance requirements, be installed on the subdivision boundaries, including solid masonry fencing on Redwood Road. Councilmember McCay
